description.narrative: The Project will support inclusive territorial development to maximize the impact and spillovers of Nador West Med complex and foster social-economic activities in the Project area. It will also help align, coordinate and synchronize the needed soft and hard investments to maximize the impact of the NWM complex on the economic activity in different provinces in the Project area. The Project will focus on three areas of intervention:(i) Component 1: Strengthening territorial development approach (ii) Component 2: Support to the private sector development readiness and competitiveness in the North-East region (i) Component 3: Improvement of road infrastructure Component 1 will support the preparation of a priority investments roadmap and a multimodal strategy to enhance the region's attractiveness to investors, based on the sectoral and local development plans under preparation. It will consolidate priority interventions in several areas (urban development, business environment, skills development, etc.) bridging the identified coordination gaps and paving the way for integrated development of the greater Nador area in preparation for the operationalization of the NWM.Component 2 will support (i) the upgrade of skills of the young workforce in the Oriental region through increased access to market-relevant skills development training and entrepreneurship opportunities, with an emphasis on girls/women, and individuals from marginalized households and (ii) the attractiveness of the region to the private sector and the identification of export-oriented value chains. Component 3 will increase the physical connectivity of NWM with the rest of the Project Area, in particular with regional poles, streamlining transit time between the port and production areas and enhancing the market potential of these poles.
To improve connectivity and enable private sector growth in the project area.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (a): The Borrower shall, through the MEE no later than thirty (30) days after the effective Date, or suchlater date as agreed with the Bank, establish, and thereafter maintain, throughout Project implementation, a Project ManagementUnit with composition, functions and responsibilities acceptable to the Bank and set forth in the Project Operational Manual,responsible for, inter alia: (i) the day-to day implementation of activities under Components 1.3, 3 and 4 of the Project; (ii) theoverall coordination, monitoring, evaluation and reporting of the Project, including consolidation of all Project information(including on fiduciary, environmental, social and technical aspects) and the preparation of Project Reports to be submitted to theBank; and (iii) serving as the secretariat of the National Project Steering Committee.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (b): The Borrower shall, through the MEE no later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, or anylater date as agreed by the Bank, prepare a manual acceptable to the Bank (“Project Operational Manual” or “POM”), and immediatelythereafter, ensure that the Project is implemented in accordance with the POM.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.2: The Borrower shall, no later than thirty (30) days after the effective Date, or such later date asagreed with the Bank, establish and thereafter maintain, throughout Project implementation, a National Project Steering Committeewith composition and terms of reference acceptable to the Bank and further described in the Project Operational Manual, to overseeProject's implementation and, in particular, ensure consistency of Project activities with Borrower's sectoral policies, review andvalidate technical, institutional, and regulatory proposals for the implementation of the Project, validate annual programs ofProject activities, and monitor their progress and timely implementation, and oversee the Project's institutional communication.
